name: Extract Document to Markdown
description: Read a document as Markdown: PDF, HTML, image (OCR), audio (returns the speech transcription), or a plain-text file (.md, .txt, .csv, .json, code — returned as is). Use this instead of file_read for anything that is not plain text — file_read returns garbage on binary files. Extracted images are saved as files and linked inline.

path.description: Path to the document (.pdf, .html, an image, an audio file, or a text file such as .md/.txt)

language.description: Audio only: ISO code (e.g. 'it') to skip auto-detection.

image_dir.description: Where to write extracted images. Default: a per-file folder under /tmp.

from_page.description: PDF only: first page to read. The output ends with the page to continue from, so a long manual is read in windows instead of always from the start.

max_pages.description: PDF only: how many pages to read starting at from_page.

images.description: PDF only: also extract the page images and link them. Pass false when you only need the text.

ocr.description: Run OCR on image files. Ignored for PDF/HTML.
